title: Goldfinch tree clips
text: Goldfinch tree clips. My Christmas has local birds on it instead of usual ornaments.  I purchased 2 sets... you get 3 in each set.  Mostly they are pretty good.  They are good size for a Goldfinch.  A couple finches had odd tail feathers, not natural and no way to change (it's how they were put together).  So it's not a perfect 5 star... but mostly good.

Perfect for any holiday Christmas (Xmas) Tree
description: Adorn your Christmas tree with a splash of color when you trim it with the Goldfinch Ornament set. These three vibrant birds remind everyone who admires your holiday decorations that sometimes the starkness of winter is the perfect opportunity to show a flair of feathered color. Coordinate with more avian ornaments to transform your home for the season. Size: 2 inches high x 4 inches wide x 1 inch deep. Material: Feather / Foam
